mechanism_narrative: An increase in the federal funds rate by more than 0.25% within a month signals a tightening monetary policy, which increases borrowing costs and reduces corporate earnings, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of instances where FEDFUNDS increases by more than 0.25% within a month.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in the unemployment rate by more than 0.5% within a month indicates a weakening labor market, which is a precursor to economic slowdown and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are positive in > 70% of instances where UNRATE increases by more than 0.5% within a month.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in real estate activity, measured by a rise in housing starts by more than 5% over two months, signals a strengthening demand side of the economy, which boosts corporate earnings and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are negative in > 50% of instances where HOUST increases by more than 5% over two months.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production by more than 2% over two months signals a contraction in the supply side of the economy, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of instances where INDPRO decreases by more than 2% over two months.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in nonfarm payrolls by more than 200,000 over a month signals a strengthening labor market, which boosts consumer spending and corporate earnings, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in > 50% of instances where PAYEMS increases by more than 200,000 over a month.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in real GDP by more than 1% over a quarter signals a strengthening economy, which boosts corporate earnings and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are negative in > 50% of quarters where GDPC1 increases by more than 1%.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate is above 2% and CPI inflation rises by more than 0.5% in a month, it signals an overheating economy, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS > 2% and CPIAUCSL increases > 0.5% in 1 month
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of instances where FEDFUNDS > 2% and CPIAUCSL increases by more than 0.5% within a month.

mechanism_narrative: When real estate activity, measured by housing starts, increases by more than 5% over two months and retail sales rise by more than 1% in the same period, it signals a robust demand environment, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: HOUST increases > 5% and RSAFS increases > 1% in 2 months
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are negative in > 50% of instances where HOUST increases by more than 5% and RSAFS increases by more than 1% over two months.
